{ $command } <status message>: set the status to { $status } with an optional status message.
{ $command } <message de stato>: defini le stato pro { $status } sin un message de stato optional.
{ $commandName }: Display a list of chat rooms on the network. Warning, some servers may disconnect you upon doing this.
{ $commandName }: monstra un lista de canales in rete. Attention, alcun servitores pote disconnecter te un vice facite isto.
{ $commandName }: Displays the current local time at the IRC server.
{ $commandName }: monstra le actual tempore local al servitor IRC.
{ $commandName }: Display the details of the room.
{ $commandName } <alias>: Create an alias for the room. Expected room alias of the form '#localname:domain'. Requires permission to add aliases.
{ $commandName } <alias>: Crea un alias pro le sala. Es expectate un alias de sala del forma '#nominelocal:dominio'. Require le permission de adder aliases.
{ $commandName } <alias>: Remove the alias for the room. Expected room alias of the form '#localname:domain'. Requires permission to remove aliases.
{ $commandName } <alias>: Remove le alias pro le sala. Es expectate un alias de sala del forma '#nominelocal:dominio'. Require le permission de remover aliases.
{ $commandName } [<channel>] [(+|-)<new mode> [<parameter>][,<parameter>]*]: Get, set, or unset a channel mode.
{ $commandName } [<canal>] [(+|-)<nove modo> [<parametro>][,<parametro>]*]: Obtene, configura, o remove un modo de canal.
{ $commandName } <command>: Send a raw command to the server.
{ $commandName } <commando>: inviar un commando crude al servitor.

{ $commandName } <guest access> <history visibility>: Set the access and history visibility of the current room for the guest users. Enter two integer values, the first for the guest access (not allowed: 0 and allowed: 1) and the second for the history visibility (not visible: 0 and visible: 1). Requires permission to change history visibility.

{ $commandName } <guest access> <history visibiilty>: Defini le accesso e visibilitate del historia del sala actual pro invitatos. Insere duo numeros integre, le primo pro le accesso de invitato (non permittite: 0 e permittite: 1) e le secunde pro le visibilitate del historia (non visibile: 0 e visibile: 1). Require le permission de cambiar le visibilitate del historia.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<message>]: Invite a user to join the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: invitar un usator a entrar in le actual canal con un message optional.
{ $commandName } <message>: Disconnect from the server, with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <message>: disconnecte del servitor, con un message optional.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: Leave the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: lassar le actual canal con un message optional.
{ $commandName } <name>: Set the name for the room. Requires permission to change the room name.
{ $commandName } <name>: Defini le nomine pro le sala. Require le permission de cambiar le nomine del sala.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<new mode>: Set or unset a user mode.
{ $commandName } [<nove topic>]: configurar le argumento de iste canal.
{ $commandName } [<nove argumento>]: configurar le argumento de iste canal.
{ $commandName } <newVersion>: Upgrade room to given version. Requires permission to upgrade the room.
{ $commandName } <newVersion>: Promove le sala al version date. Require le permission de promover le sala.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel operator status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <pseudo1>[,<pseudo2>]*: accordar le stato de operator de canal a alcuno. Tu debe ser un operator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel voice status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <pseudo1>[,<pseudo2>]*: accordar a alcuno le stato de voce de canal. Tu debe ser un operator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel operator status from someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: remove stato operator de canal ab alcuno. Tu debe ser un operator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel voice status from someone, preventing them from speaking if the channel is moderated (+m). You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: remove stato operator de canal ab alcuno, impediente les de parlar si le canal es moderate (+m). Tu debe ser un operator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } [<nick>]: Asks how much lag a user (or the server if no user specified) has.
{ $commandName } [<pseudonymo>]: demanda quanto lag ha un usator (o le servitor si nulle usator es specificate).
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Ban someone from the room. You must be a room administrator to do this.
{ $commandName } <pseudo>[<message>]: blocar alicuno del canal. Tu debe ser un administrator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } <nick> [<message>]: Remove someone from a channel. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick> [<message>]: remove alcuno ex un canal. Tu debe ser un operator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Remove someone from the room. You must be a room moderator to do this.
{ $commandName } <pseudo>[<message>]: remover alicuno del canal. Tu debe ser un administrator de canal pro facer isto.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a participant in the room.
{ $commandName } <pseudo> <message>: Inviar un message private a un participante del canal.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a user (as opposed to a channel).
{ $commandName } <pseudo> <message>: Inviar un message private a un usator (in vice que a un canal).
{ $commandName } <nick> [(+|-)<mode>]: Get, set or unset a user's mode.
{ $commandName } <nick> [(+|-)<modo>]: Obtene, configura o remove un modo de usator.
{ $commandName } <nick> <msg>: Sends a CTCP message to the nick.
{ $commandName } <nick> <msg>: invia un message CTCP al supernomine.
{ $commandName } <nick>[ <nick>]* [<channel>]: Invite one or more nicks to join you in the current channel, or to join the specified channel.
{ $commandName } <nick>[ <nick>]* [<channel>]: invita un o plus pseudonymos a junger se al canal actual o a junger se al canal specificate.
{ $commandName } <nick>: Request the version of a user's client.
{ $commandName } <pseudo>: Requestar le version del cliente de un usator.
{ $commandName } <nick!user@host>: Ban the users matching the given pattern.
{ $commandName } <nick!user@host>: blocar le usatores concordante le patrono date.
{ $commandName } <room1>[ <key1>][,<room2>[ <key2>]]*: Enter one or more channels, optionally providing a channel key for each if needed.
{ $commandName } <room1>[ <key1>][,<room2>[ <key2>]]*: Insere un o plus canales, que forni optionalmente un clave de canal pro cata uno si necessari.
{ $commandName } [<room>[@<server>][/<nick>]] [<password>]: Join a room, optionally providing a different server, or nickname, or the room password.
{ $commandName } [<canal>[@<servitor>][/<pseudo>]] [<contrasigno>]: entrar in un canal forniente un servitor o un pseudonymo differente, o le contrasigno del canal.
{ $commandName } <room jid>[<password>]: Invite your conversation partner to join a room, together with its password if required.
{ $commandName } <canal jid>[<contrasigno>]: Invita tu companion de conversation a entrar in un canal, insimul con su contrasigno si necessari.
{ $commandName } <target> <message>: Send a notice to a user or channel.
{ $commandName } <destino> <message>: inviar un aviso a un usator o canal.
{ $commandName } <topic>: Set the topic for the room. Requires permissions to change the room topic.
{ $commandName } <topic>: Defini le subjecto pro le sala. Require permissiones pro cambiar le subjecto del sala.
{ $commandName } <userId>: Invite the user to the room.
{ $commandName } <IDdelUsator>: Invitar le usator a entrar in le sala.
{ $commandName } <userId> <message>: Send a direct message to the given user.
{ $commandName } <userId> <message>: invia un message directe al usator date.

{ $commandName } <userId> [<power level>]: Define the power level of the user. Enter an integer value, User: 0, Moderator: 50 and Admin: 100. Default will be 50 if no argument is provided. Requires permission to change member's power levels. Does not work on admins other than yourself.

{ $commandName } <userId> [<nivello de potentia>]: defini le nivello de potentia del usator. Insere un valor de numero integre, Usator: 0, Moderator: 50 e Administrator: 100. Le valor predefinite es 50 si nulle argumento es fornite. Require permission pro cambiar le nivellos de potentia del membros. Non functiona pro administratores altere que tu mesme.
{ $commandName } <userId> [<reason>]: Ban the user with the userId from the room with optional reason message. Requires permission to ban users.
{ $commandName } <IDdelUsator> [<motivo>]: Bannir le usator specificate del sala con un message facultative de motivo. Require le permission de bannir usatores.
{ $commandName } <userId> [<reason>]: Kick the user with the userId from the room with optional reason message. Requires permission to kick users.
{ $commandName } <IDdelUsator> [<motivo>]: Ejectar le usator specificate del sala con un message facultative de motivo. Require le permission de ejectar usatores.
{ $commandName } <userId>: Reset the user to power level 0 (User). Requires permission to change member's power levels. Does not work on admins other than yourself.

{ $commandName } <userId>: reinitialisa le usator a nivello de potentia 0 (Usator). Require permission pro cambiar le nivellos de potentia del membros. Non functiona pro administratores altere que tu mesme.
{ $commandName } <userId>: Unban a user who is banned from the room. Requires permission to ban users.
{ $commandName } <userId>: Disbloca un usator qui es bannite del sala. Require le permission de bannir usatores.

{ $commandName } [<visibility>]: Set the visibility of the current room in the current Home Server's room directory. Enter an integer value, Private: 0 and Public: 1. Default will be Private (0) if no argument is provided. Requires permission to change room visibility.

{ $commandName } [<visibility>]: Defini le visibilitate del sala actual in le directorio del Servitor principal actual. Insere un valor de numero integre, Private: 0 e Public: 1. Le valor predefinite es Private (0) si nulle argumento es fornite. Require le permission de cambiar le visibilitate del sala.
{ $commandName } [message]: Leave the current channel with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [message]: abandona le canal actual con un message optional.
{ $commandName }: Request information about the client your conversation partner is using.
{ $commandName }: Requestar informationes sur le cliente que tu companion de conversation usa.

Email has been and continues to be the fundamental communication tool and a significant driver of freedoms on the Internet. But it is also threatened by new non-standards-based, closed and centralized messaging platforms. To prevent this erosion, the public deserves an alternative that is secure and reliable, while protecting our privacy, enhancing our productivity and serving as a platform for current and future forms of messaging.

Le email ha essite e continua a esser le utensile de communication fundamental e un significante motor de libertates in internet. Ma illo es alsi menaciate per nove platteformas de messages non standard, clause e centralisate. Pro impedir iste erosion, le publico merita un alternativa secur e fidabile, que dum protege nostre confidentialitate, meliora nostre productivitate e serve como platteforma pro actual e futur formas de messages.

End-to-end encryption for email can be used to ensure that only the sender and the recipients of a message can read the contents. Without this protection it is easy for email providers and mass surveillance to read your messages. If you would like to learn more about how end-to-end encryption in Thunderbird works, check out our article: Introduction to End-to-end encryption in Thunderbird.

Le cryptographia end-to-end pro le e-mails pote esser usate pro assecurar que solo le expeditor e le destinatarios de un message poter leger le contentos. Sin iste protection il es facile pro fornitores de servicios e-mail e le surveliantia de massa leger tu messages. Si tu vole saper plus re como functiona le cryptographia end-to-end in Thunderbird, discoperi nostre articulo:Introduction a Cryptographia end-to-end in Thunderbird.

Managing multiple calendars has been made easier with the calendar sidebar improvements in this release. There is a quick enable button for disabled calendars, a lock indicator for read-only calendars, and a show/hide icon for easily toggling what calendars are visible. One of the most noticeable changes for Thunderbird 91 is the new account setup wizard. The new wizard not only features a better look, but does auto-discovery of calendars and address books and allows most users to set them up with just a click. After setting up an account, the wizard also points users at additional (optional) things to do – such as adding a signature or setting up end-to-end encryption.

Post le implementation de un conto, le assistente alsi consilia le usatores pro altere (optional) cosas a facer – tal como adder un firma o le preparation de cryptation de un extremo al altere.

Deberea io usar le version beta?

Simply install beta over top of your current program directory, using the default installer choices. Beta will then <u>use your current (production) default profile</u>. Because it uses your default profile, this choice makes it more difficult to switch back to using a release version should you wish to do so in the future. In other words, you should not switch back and forth between beta and normal release using the same profile.

Simplemente installa le version beta super le parte superior de tu actual directorio de programma, per le electiones predefinite del installator. Le version beta alora <u>usara tu actual profilo predefinite (production)</u>. Pois que illo usa tu profilo predefinite, iste selection rende plus difficile passar retro a usar un version, si deberea tu voler de facer assi in le futuro. In altere terminos, tu non debe passar retro e avante inter le versiones beta e normal per le mesme profilo.

Thunderbird es e libere e respectuose del libertate, ma nos es alsi completemente financiate per donationes! Adjuta nos a sustener e continuar a meliorar le projecto.
Thunderbird’s mission is to offer a time and privacy-respecting, customizable communication experience that gives you control of your data and experience. Free to everyone!

Le mission de Thunderbird es de offerer un experientia de communication personalisabile, respectuose de vostre tempore e confidentialitate, que da vos controlo de vostre datos e experientia. Gratis pro totes!
We can’t do this without you! If you get value from using Thunderbird, please consider giving a donation to support this goal.
Nos non lo pote facer sin te! Si tu obtene valor ab le uso de Thunderbird, considera facer un donation pro supportar iste objectivo.
Without you, Thunderbird can’t exist. Giving a gift today means Thunderbird continues to remain available!
Sin vos, Thunderbird non potera exister. Faciente un dono hodie, vos assecura la perennitate de Thunderbird!
Supernova continues to iterate on the modernized Address Book introduced in Thunderbird 102. You’ll enjoy a new tabular view, an improved Edit view, delete buttons, and better accessibility.

Supernova continua a meliorar le Libro de adresses modernisate introducite in Thunderbird 102. Tu fruera un nove vista tabular, un melior vista pro Rediger, buttones pro deler, e melior accessibilitate.

Supernova features a single dynamic toolbar, presenting frequently used and contextual options based on the tab or Space that is currently active. Take full control by customizing the toolbar and window layout to perfectly fit your workflow.

Supernova presenta un singule barra del instrumentos dynamic, monstrante optiones frequentemente usate e contextual basate super le schedas o spatios currentemente active. Prende controlo plen per personalisar le barra del instrumentos e mappa de fenestra pro esser perfectemente apte a tu fluxo de labor.

Supernova gives you more control by introducing sortable Folder Modes. Display all of your Tags in the Folder Pane, turn on and off Local Folders, or move your favorite Folder Mode sections up and down with one click. Less scrolling, more productivity.

Supernova te da plus controlo introducente nove Modos de plicas classificabile. Monstra tote tu etiquettas in le Pannello de plica, activa e disactiva Plicas local, o move in alto e a basso tu sectiones favorite de Modo de plica, con un clic. Minor rolamento, major productivitate.

Supernova is constantly evolving. Throughout the next year, we’ll deliver many improvements to existing Supernova features and introduce brand new ones. Upgrade to version 115 and experience the future of Thunderbird!

Supernova es constantemente in evolution. Durante le anno proxime, nos fornira multe meliorationes al functiones existente de Supernova e introducera los nove de fabrica. Promove al version 115 e discoperi le futuro de Thunderbird!

Supernova’s new Card View is our version of the well-known vertical layout for the Message List, perfect for people used to modern webmail. Card View emulates a mobile interface list with multi-line support, offering a more comfortable appearance to reduce cognitive burden.

Le nove Vista del schedas de Supernova es nostre version del ben note mappa vertical pro le lista del messages, perfecte pro gente habituate al moderne email web. Le Vista del schedas emula un lista de interfacie mobile con supporto multilinea, offere un plus confortabile apparentia pro reducer le onere cognitive.

Supernova substantially improves Thunderbird’s keyboard navigation and screen reader accessibility across the entire application. We’ve also greatly expanded the ability to navigate Mail content and buttons using the TAB and arrow keys.

Supernova substantialmente meliora le navigation per claviero de Thunderbird e accessibilitate del lector de schermo a transverso le integre application. Nos ha alsi grandemente expandite le capacitate de navigar per contento e buttones del posta per le claves TAB e flechas.
Classificator de Supporto & Bugs, Regno Unite

Tags are a familiar and powerful part of your workflow, so Supernova adds an eye-catching “Tags” view to the Folder Pane. Quickly jump to your custom, color-coded tag categories to find and filter your messages even faster.

Le etiquettas es un familiar e potente parte de tu fluxo de labor, assi Supernova adde un vista attrahente del “Etiquettas” al Pannello de plicas. Presto salta a tu personal, categorias de etiquettas con codice de color pro trovar e filtrar tu messages mesmo plus velocemente.
Probator e Classificator de bugs, Statos Unite de America
Thank you for contacting us. A case has been created for your issue and we will be in touch shortly.

Thank you for downloading and installing Thunderbird!

Thank you for supporting Thunderbird, which is funded by users like you! Producing Thunderbird requires software engineers, designers, system administrators and server infrastructure. So if you like Thunderbird, the best way to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation.

Assi si il te place Thunderbird, le melior maniera de assecura te que Thunderbird remane disponibile es de facer un donation.

Thank you for using Thunderbird Beta. Your experiences with beta are important, so please report rough edges, bugs, and provide feedback in the ways suggested below - to help make the next Thunderbird release as awesome as possible.

The Account Setup window and the Account Central tab have both been updated. The Account Central tab appears when you do not have an account setup, or when you select an existing account in the folder tree.

Le fenestra de configuration de conto e le scheda Centro de contos ha essite actualisate. Le scheda Centro de contos appare si tu non ha un conto configurate o si tu selige un conto existente in le arbore de dossiers.

The Activity Manager records all the interactions between Thunderbird and your email provider in one place. There’s no more guess work. You only have to look in one place to see everything that’s happening with your email.

Le gestor de activitate registra tote le interactiones inter Thunderbird e tu fornitor de posta electronic in un loco central. Finite le necessitate de divinar. Tu debe solo reguardar in un sol loco pro vider tote lo que eveni con tu correspondentia.
Le novissime Barra del instrumentos unificate
The attachment reminder looks for the word attachment (and other words like file types) in the body of your message and reminds you to add an attachment before hitting send.
Le rememoration de annexos cerca le parola "annexo" (e altere parolas que pote indicar typos de file) in le corpore de tu message e te rememora de adder un annexo ante de inviar le message.

The attachments pane has been moved to the bottom of the compose window for better visibility of filenames as well as being able to see many at once. We’ve also added an overlay that appears when you drag-and-drop a file into the compose window asking how you would like to handle the file in that email (such as putting a picture in-line in your message or simply attaching it to the email).

Le pannello annexos ha essite movite al parte inferior del fenestra de composition pro melior visibilitate de nomines de file e pro poter vider multe contemporaneemente. Nos ha alsi addite un superposition que appare quando tu trahe e depone un file in le fenestra de composition demandante como tu vole gerer le file in ille e-mail (tal como poner un photo in-line in tu message o simplemente annexante lo al e-mail).

The compose window has been reworked to make composing a message faster, easier and more straightforward. The compose window now also takes up less space with recipients listed in “pills” instead of an entire line for each address.

Le fenestra de composition ha essite re-laborate pro render le composition de un message plus veloce, plus facile e ancora plus immediate. Le fenestra de composition ora alsi prende minus spatio con le destinatarios listate in “pilulas” in vice del un integre linea pro cata adresse.
The Daily version is an unstable testing and development platform, make sure you back up important data regularly!
Le Daily es un platteforma instabile de test e disveloppamento, preserva tu datos importante regularmente!
The dark theme available in Thunderbird has been enhanced with a dark message thread pane as well as many other small improvements.
Le thema obscur disponibile in Thunderbird ha essite meliorate con un quadro de discussion e multe altere micre meliorationes.

The entire world deserves free and open source software, and Thunderbird is currently translated in more than 50 languages! Use your multilingual talents to help make Thunderbird more widely available than ever.

Tote le mundo merita software gratuite e open-source, e Thunderbird es actualmente traducite in plus que 50 linguas! Usa tu talentos multilingue pro adjutar a render Thunderbird plus largemente disponibile que mais.
The improved address book edit pane
Le pannello edition libro de adresses meliorate

The layout and dialogues have been improved to make it easier to understand the information displayed and to find relevant settings. The Account Central tab also has new information about the Thunderbird project and displays the version you are using.

Le disposition e le dialogos ha essite meliorate pro render plus facile comprender le informationes monstrate e trovar le parametros pertinente. In ultra, le scheda Centro de contos ha nove informationes sur le projecto Thunderbird e monstra le version que tu usa.

Themes allow you to change the look of Thunderbird in an instant. Working on getting to inbox zero at night? Turn on the dark theme to make managing your email easier on the eyes. Thunderbird ships with both light and dark themes, and more are available as add-ons.

Le themas te permitte de cambiar le apparentia de Thunderbird in un instante. Labora tu le nocte pro vacuar le cassa de entrata? Activa le thema obscur pro gerer tu e-mail de maniera plus confortabile al oculos. Thunderbird ha themas clar e obscur, e multe alteres es disponibile como additivos.

The new Application Menu (≡) in Supernova is now keyboard-accessible, and redesigned for faster, easier navigation. Fewer submenus, persistent global options, and consistent iconography combine to create a much more intuitive experience.

Le nove Menu del application (≡) in Supernova es ora accessibile per claviero, e redesignate pro navigar plus velocemente e, plus facilemente. Poc sub-menus, optiones global persistente, e le iconographia coherente se combina pro crear un experientia multo plus intuitive.
The new Preferences tab also makes it easier to multi-task without the problem of losing track of where your preferences are when switching between windows.
Le nove scheda Preferentias alsi simplifica le multi-task sin le problema de perdita tracia de ubi es tu preferentias quando tu commuta inter fenestras.

The Quick Filter Toolbar lets you filter your email faster. Start typing in words in the Quick Filter search box and the results are displayed instantly. Or you can filter your email by New Messages, Tags, and people in your Address Book. You can also "Pin" or save a Filter and use it across multiple folders.

Le barra de filtros rapide te permitte filtrar tu messages plus velocemente. Comencia a scriber parolas in le quadro de recerca del filtro, e le resultatos appare instantaneemente. O tu pote filtrar tu e-mail per nove messages, etiquettas, e personas in tu adressario. Tu pote etiam "fixar" o salvar un filtro e usar lo inter plure dossiers.

Le fenestra de composition redesignate simplifica le gestion de multe destinatarios de e-mails e le nove intuitive disposition adjuta usatores a discoperir su functionalitates.

The search interface in Thunderbird contains filtering and timeline tools to pinpoint the exact email you’re looking for. Thunderbird also indexes all of your emails and chat conversations to help you search even faster. Your search results are displayed in a tab so you can easily switch back and forth to your search results and other email.

Thunderbird alsi provide de indice tote tu emails e chats, pro adjutar te a los trovar mesmo plus velocemente. Le resultatos appare in un scheda, de sorta que tu pote facilemente passar e repassar inter tu resultatos de recerca e altere messages.

This year, we delivered outstanding visual changes in Thunderbird 115 and other major improvements. In 2024, we want to make our privacy-respecting email software available to billions. Imagine Thunderbird on your Android and iOS devices!

Iste anno, nos livrava pendente cambiamentos visual in Thunderbird 115 e altere major meliorationes. In le 2024, nos rendera disponibile pro billiones nostre software de emails respectuose del confidentialitate. Imagina Thunderbird sur tu apparatos Android e iOS!

Thunderbird 102 and newer on Windows will install beta into its own program directory. For older versions on Windows consult the beta support article. For other operating systems use an install method appropriate for your OS to target a uniquely named directory.

Thunderbird 102 e plus recente sur Windows installara le version beta in su proprie directorio de programma. Pro le versiones plus vetere sur Windows consulta le articulo de assistentia del version beta. Pro altere systemas operative usa un methodo de installation appropriate pro tu systema operative pro destinar un directorio univocamente nominate.

Thunderbird 102 gives your contacts a serious upgrade! The refreshed design makes it easier to navigate and interact with your contacts, and helps you better understand who you’re communicating with. The new Address Book has compatibility with vCard specs, meaning if your app can export your existing contacts into vCard format, Thunderbird can import them. Each contact card also acts as a launchpad for messaging, email, and event creation.

Thunderbird 102 te adjuta a esser plus productive con minus effortio. Le nove designo simplifica navigar e interager con tu contactos, e te adjuta a melio comprender con qui tu communica. Le nove Libro de adresses ha compatibilitate con le specificationes de vCard, assi si tu app pote exportar tu existente contactos in formato vCard, Thunderbird pote importar los. Cata scheda de contacto alsi age como placa de lanceamento de messages, email, e creation de eventos.

Thunderbird 102 helps you be more productive with less effort. When reading your email, the redesigned message header allows you to focus on what matters as it highlights important information. It’s also more responsive and easier to navigate. Plus, you can star important messages from the message header itself, and easily convert them into a calendar event or a task.

Thunderbird 102 te adjuta a esser plus productive con minus effortio. Legente tu email, le titulo del message redesignate te permitte de concentrar te sur lo que importa, pois que illo evidentia le informationes importante. Illo es alsi plus reactive e plus facile pro navigar. In ultra, tu pote marcar con asterisco le messages importante ab lor mesme titulo, e facilemente converter los in un evento o un labor de agenda.

Thunderbird 102 makes it quick and simple to move your accounts and data around. The new step-by-step wizard provides a guided experience for importing all that data that’s important to you. We’ve also taken extra precautions to ensure that no data is accidentally duplicated in your profile after an import. Moving from Outlook, SeaMonkey, or another Thunderbird installation is easier than ever. No add-ons required!

Thunderbird 102 rende rapide e simple mover circum tu contos e datos. Le nove assistente detaliate offere un experientia guidate pro le importation de tote le datos importante pro te. Nos ha alsi prendite extra precautiones pro assecurar que nulle datos es accidentalmente duplicate in tu profilo post un importation. Displaciar ab Outlook, SeaMonkey, o un altere installation Thunderbird es plus facile que unquam. Nulle additivos necesse!

Thunderbird 102 makes navigating the application more intuitive thanks to the new Spaces Toolbar. Move between all of your activities with ease, whether it’s managing email, working with contacts through the awesome new address book, using the calendar and tasks functionality, chat, and even add-ons! If you want to save screen real estate, the Spaces Toolbar can be dismissed, and you can instead navigate the different activities Thunderbird offers with the new Pinned Spaces tab.

Thunderbird 102 rende plus intuitive navigar inter le applicationes gratias al nove Barra del spatio. Move te inter tote tu activitates facilemente, sia illo gerer email, collaborar con contactos per le stupende nove libro de adresses, per le agenda e le functionalitate de activitates, chat, e mesmo additivos! Si tu desira sparniar spatio de schermo, le Barra del instrumentos de spatio pote esser eliminate, e tu pote in vice navigar inter le differente activitates que Thunderbird offere con le nove scheda de spatios appunctate.

Thunderbird 102 offere un nove maniera de chattar reservatemente e con securitate con tu collegas, amicos e familia. Thunderbird facilitates cross platform, decentralized, open-standard communication, which puts the user in control of their data and workflow. We aspire to offer an interoperable and extensible open-source platform for messaging and managing personal information, such as email, contacts, and appointments.

Thunderbird facilita le communicationes inter platteformas, decentralisate, a standard aperte, que pone le usator al commando de lor datos e de lor fluxo de labor. Nos aspira offerer un platteforma inter-operabile e open-source extensibile, pro messages e pro gerer informationes personal, tal como email, contactos, e appunctamentos.

Thunderbird is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and calendaring client, that’s easy to set up and customize. One of the core principles of Thunderbird is the use and promotion of open standards - this focus is a rejection of our world of closed platforms and services that can’t communicate with each other. We want our users to have freedom and choice in how they communicate.

Thunderbird es un application libere e gratuite de posta electronic, de notitias, de conversation in directo e de agenda, facile a configurar e personalisar. Un del principios fundamental de Thunderbird es le uso e promotion de standards aperte – le rejection del systemas e servicios clause que non pote communicar le unes con le alteres. Thunderbird is a free and open-source software project founded in 2003 to make communicating and collaborating better. Thunderbird is an independent project with its legal and financial home at the Mozilla Foundation. The Mozilla Foundation believes the Internet is a global public resource that must remain open and accessible to all. It is focused on advocacy issues and keeping the Internet healthy, but is also the sole shareholder in the maker of Firefox, the Mozilla Corporation. Mozilla exerts no governance over the project, which instead falls to the Thunderbird Council, elected by the Thunderbird project’s community. The Mozilla Foundation became Thunderbird’s home after an exploration of legal homes in 2017.

Thunderbird es un projecto independente con su sede juridic e financiari in le Fundation Mozilla. Illo se concentra sur le questiones de activismo e sanitate de Internet, ma etiam es le sol actionista in le productor de Firefox, le Mozilla Corporation. Mozilla non governa le projecto; isto face le Consilio de Thunderbird, eligite per le communitate del projecto. Le Fundation Mozilla deveniva le sede de Thunderbird post un exploration de sedes juridic in 2017.

Thunderbird protects you from email scams which try to trick users into handing over personal and confidential information by indicating when a message is a potential phishing attempt. As a second line of defense, Thunderbird warns you when you click on a link which appears to be taking you to a different Web site than the one indicated by the URL in the message.

Como secunde linea de defensa, Thunderbird te adverti quando tu clicca sur un ligamine que pare portar te a un sito web differente de illo indicate per le adresse URL monstrate in le message.

Thunderbird’s popular junk mail tools have been updated to stay ahead of spam. Each email you receive passes through Thunderbird’s leading-edge junk mail filters. Each time you mark messages as spam, Thunderbird "learns" and improves its filtering so you can spend more time reading the mail that matters. Thunderbird can also use your mail provider’s spam filters to keep junk mail out of your inbox.

Thunderbird’s update system checks to see if you’re running the latest version, and notifies you when a security update is available. These security updates are small (usually 200KB - 700KB), giving you only what you need and making the security update quick to download and install. The automated update system provides updates for Thunderbird on Windows, macOS, and Linux in over 40 different languages.

Le systema de actualisation automatisate forni actualisationes pro Thunderbird sur Windows, macOS e Linux in plus de 40 linguas.

When making a one-time gift through SEPA direct debit, you may notice a mention of recurrent transactions. This is because our payment processor Stripe only supports recurring transactions for this type of payment. Regardless of this, we will only charge you once and we will not make any further payments on your account without your authorization. Following the mandate, you will receive an official donation receipt that will clearly reflect the one-time donation.

Quando tu face un dono non repetibile per un debito directe SEPA, tu pote esser avisate de un transaction recurrente. Isto es perque nostre processor de pagamento Stripe solo supporta transactiones recurrente pro iste typo de pagamento. Sin importantia de isto, nos solo te cargara un vice e nos non rendera alcun altere pagamentos sur tu conto sin tu autorisation. Sequente le mandato, tu recipera un quitantia de donation official que clarmente reflectera le donation non repetibile.
When quitting Thunderbird, visible tabs will be saved and will be restored when you open Thunderbird the next time. There is also a Tab menu on the Tab toolbar to help you switch between Tabs.

Quando tu quita Thunderbird, le schedas visibile es salvate e se restaura quando tu aperi Thunderbird le proxime vice. Il ha etiam un menu Schedas sur le barra de instrumentos Schedas que te adjuta a commutar inter schedas.

When you donate via our online form, simply check the box 'Donate as an Organization' and include your company name. The receipt you receive to the email address used to make your contribution will include your business information.

Quando tu ha donate via nostre modulo online, simplemente marca le quadrato 'Donar como organisation' e include le nomine de tu compania. Le quitantia que tu recipe al adresse email usate pro facer tu contributiones includera tu informationes commercial.

When you opt to cover our transaction costs, you're covering both our processing and donation platform costs. The costs associated with our robust online donation system allows us to continue scaling sustainably as our supporter-base grows. Our donation platform and payment processor partners reduce internal costs associated with maintaining our own system from scratch. Our partners ensure we can accept a wide range of currencies/payment methods and remain PCI compliant in all of the countries that we accept gifts from. The transaction costs donors may choose to cover are based on an estimate of our overall costs. Due to many factors actual costs may fluctuate.

Quando tu opta pro coperir nostre costos de transaction, tu coperi ambe nostre costos de processo e de platteforma de donation. Le costos associate con nostre robuste systema de donation online permitte nos de continuar a scalar sustenibilemente dum nostre base de contributores cresce. Nostre socios de platteforma de donation e processor de pagamento reduce le costos interne associate con le mantenimento de nostre proprie systema ex novo. Nostre socios assecura que nos pote acceptar un large selection de monetas/methodos pagamento e restar observante PCI in tote le paises ab le qual nos accepta donos. Le costos de transaction que le donatores pote seliger de coperir es basate sur un estima de nostre in costos synthetic. Le costos pote fluctuar per multe factores actual.

Whether it’s work or play, you deserve to have privacy when you are online. A VPN, Virtual Private Network, can help you create a secure, private connection to the internet. So that when you are traveling, connecting to WiFi, or simply want more online security - you know that your information is protected from prying eyes.

Sia que tu labora o joca, tu merita haber confidentialitate quando tu es online. Un VPN, Rete virtual private, pote adjutar te crear un connexion a internet secur, private. Assi que quando tu viagia, te connecte te a wi-fi o simplemente vole plus securitate online, tu sape que tu informationes es protegite contra oculos indiscrete.

Whether you are using it on a large desktop monitor or a small laptop touchscreen, you may want the icons and text of the interface to be larger and more spread out or very compact. In Thunderbird 91, under View -> Density in the menu, you can select the UI density for the entire application. Three options are available: compact (small), normal(medium), and touch(large).

Sia que tu lo usa un grande schermo de scriptorio o un micre schermo tactile de portabile, tu pote voler aggrandir e separar le icones e le texto del interfacie, o multo los compactar. In le menu de Thunderbird 91, sub Vider -> Densitate, tu pote eliger le densitate del interfacie de usator pro le integre application. Tres optiones es disponibile: compacte (micre), normal(medie), e tactile (grande).

Yes, we use industry-standard SSL technology to keep your information secure. We partner with Stripe, the industry's established payment processor trusted by some of the world's largest companies. Your sensitive financial information never touches our servers. We send all data directly to Stripe's PCI-compliant servers through SSL. We understand that your privacy is very important. For complete information please refer to the Mozilla Privacy Policy.

Si, nos usa le technologia standard SSL del industria pro mantener tu informationes secur. Nos collabora con Stripe, un processator de pagamentos que es ben establite in le industria e in le qual alcunes del plus grande interprisas del mundo ha confidentia. Tu informationes financiari sensibile non attinge jammais nostre servitores. Nos invia tote le datos directemente per SSL al servitores de Stripe conforme al normas PCI. Nos comprende ben le importantia de tu vita private. Pro informationes complete, refere te al Politica de confidentialitate de Mozilla.

Improve the speed of sending email and avoid message rejection if the recipient’s server disallows large files. As an added bonus, you’ll also save space in your sent folder and the recipient’s inbox.

Meliora le velocitate de inviar e-mail e evita le rejection de messages si le servitor del destinatario non permitte grande files. Como un bonus extra, tu economisa spatio in tu dossier de messages inviate e in le cassa de entrata del destinatario.

Your donation may be eligible for a refund. You must contact us within 15 days after the date of the donation. If you believe this donation was made without your authorization, please contact us immediately. Donations made via ACH or SEPA direct debit are ineligible for refunds. Due to the nature of these transactions our policy prioritizes minimizing refund fraud. We sincerely appreciate your understanding. If you have any further questions, please contact us.

Tu donation pote esser eligibile pro un reimbursamento. Tu debe contactar nos intra 15 dies post le data del donation. Si tu crede que iste donation era facite sin tu autorisation, contacta nos immediatemente. Le donationes facite via domiciliation ACH o SEPA es ineligibile pro reimbursamentos. Per le natura de iste transactiones nostre regulamento da prioritate a minimisar fraudes de reimbursamento. Nos sincermente apprecia vostre comprension. Si vos ha alcun altere questiones, contacta nos.

The Mozilla IoT remote access service and automatic software updates are being discontinued. Choose whether to transfer to the community-run webthings.io for continued service.

The Mozilla IoT remote access service and automatic software updates are being discontinued on 31st December 2020 (find out more). Mozilla is transitioning the project to the new community-run webthings.io (not affiliated with Mozilla).

If you do not wish to continue receiving software updates from community-run update servers, you can disable automatic updates in Settings.

If you would like to transfer your mozilla-iot.org subdomain to webthings.io, or register a new subdomain, you can fill out the form below to register for the replacement community-run remote access service.

Le servicio de accesso remote e actualisationes automatic del software de Mozilla IoT va esser discontinuate le 31 decembre 2020 (discoperi plus). Mozilla va actuar le transition del projecto al nove sito web webthings.io (non affiliate a Mozilla) gerite per le communitate.

Si tu non vole continuar reciper actualisationes del software ab le servitores de actualisation gerite per le communitate, tu pote disactivar le actualisationes automatic in Parametros.
